message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV with pd.read_csv and immediately processes it without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape validations, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path supplied via CLI argument; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the file.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no check on label distributions, validation of label values against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool used before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Although IsolationForest is used as a model, it is not applied as a pre-training filter on the dataset to remove poisoned samples; there are no outlier detection or statistical anomaly checks performed on the data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code only trains new models from scratch (IsolationForest, OneClassSVM, RandomForestClassifier) and saves them via utils.save_transform; it never loads pretrained or serialized models, so there is no integrity verification to observe.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no class balance checks or label-set validation before training; it only uses top-k selection heuristics to subset training data without verifying label distributions.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented anywhere in the training loop or utility functions.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) or DP mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress-testing logic anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads the CSV directly with pd.read_csv and passes it through construct_features and scale_data without any shape, range, type, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The model_evaluation function computes metrics but there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks applied to model outputs before use or return.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular ML models (IsolationForest, OneClassSVM, RandomForest), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
